runtime.worker_extraction: Every start re-verifies the retained archive and privately extracts only llama-cli and lib* shared libraries. llama-server, rpc-server and every other runtime executable are excluded.
runtime.transport: one BPM-owned direct child process over stdin/stdout only

inference_profile.reasoning_output: Thought tags are removed before worker output; raw template and hidden reasoning are not exposed.
inference_profile.structured_output: M13-06B supplies a fixed local GBNF grammar that permits only the answer/terminal section JSON shapes. The required --no-show-timings flag prevents llama-cli from appending its human timing footer to that machine JSON stream. Every generation receives a fresh llama-cli child, then releases it: the controller alone supplies the bounded retained dialogue and native KV history cannot cross BPM requests. The grammar constrains syntax, not facts: current-evidence citation resolution, plain-text checks, quotation rejection and safe terminal handling remain server-owned.

resource_and_lifecycle.start_trigger: only an explicit later controller generation call after verified model and runtime checks; no startup, page load, lexical search, status poll, rejected chat, background retry or make dev invocation starts a worker
resource_and_lifecycle.concurrency: one active generation; a second request is rejected busy without another worker
resource_and_lifecycle.cancel: terminates the dedicated process group; unload clears the private runtime directory and in-process conversation state
resource_and_lifecycle.failure: timeout, crash, invalid runtime/model or protocol failure is fail-closed. Assistant health is not ready while lexical search and existing /health/ready remain ready.
resource_and_lifecycle.diagnostics: health returns only state, stable reason code, readiness booleans and runtime identity; it never returns prompts, output, evidence, paths, secrets or raw exceptions.
resource_and_lifecycle.local_timing: Before an accepted request only, the worker may expose process-local CPU-thread count, fixed model identity/quantization/runtime, cold-or-warm state and a four-sample rolling generated-token throughput to the response-time estimator. It starts no worker, creates no hardware identifier, and never logs, persists, telemeters or returns a measurement to the browser.

development_handoff.source: the checksum-pinned M6-03 archive cache copied by explicit make target
development_handoff.persistence: The verified archive is stored under data/ai/runtime and is preserved by clean-local-artifacts. A later make dev only verifies it; it does not start or remove the worker/runtime.
development_handoff.release_boundary: This developer bootstrap is not a release UI. BPM093-M10-03A owns the product installation/removal UI.
